name: Reporte Diario de Ventas, Gastos y Stock Bajo (GDA POS)

parameters.query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(id) AS total_operaciones,
  COALESCE(SUM(total), 0) AS total_vendido,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(metodo_pago) LIKE '%efectivo%' THEN total ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_efectivo,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(metodo_pago) LIKE '%transferencia%' THEN total ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_transferencia,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(metodo_pago) LIKE '%tarjeta%' THEN total ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_tarjeta,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(metodo_pago) NOT LIKE '%efectivo%' AND LOWER(metodo_pago) NOT LIKE '%transferencia%' AND LOWER(metodo_pago) NOT LIKE '%tarjeta%' THEN total ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_otros
FROM ventas
WHERE creado_en >= CURRENT_DATE AND creado_en < CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '1 day';

SELECT 
  COUNT(id) AS cantidad_gastos,
  COALESCE(SUM(monto), 0) AS total_gastos
FROM gastos
WHERE creado_en >= CURRENT_DATE AND creado_en < CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '1 day';

SELECT 
  codigo,
  nombre,
  stock_actual,
  precio_venta
FROM productos
WHERE stock_actual <= 5
ORDER BY stock_actual ASC
LIMIT 10;
